claim.statement: Reproduce the public model-card zero-shot image-classification usage surface for google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 on the documented parrot image and candidate labels animals, humans, and landscape.
limitations: This is an engineering reproduction specimen, not a reproduction of the SigLIP 2 paper's benchmark tables.
The model card does not publish a required numeric score for this example; the study therefore records scores and uses the semantically expected top-label condition only as a bounded harness check.

The upstream image URL is mutable; the runtime must record the exact acquired-byte SHA-256 and realized-input SHA-256. A future Foundry benchmark/stimulus registration may pin the image more strongly.

execution_conditions: All declared model files match the Foundry-recorded SHA-256 identities before inference.
The exact declared model revision loads without trust_remote_code.
Image and text logits are finite.
The acquired image bytes and realized model input are SHA-256 identified.
Selected vision-layer activation summaries are bounded and finite.
A result record separates execution disposition from scientific disposition.
scientific_conditions: For the documented parrot image and labels, animals is the highest-scoring candidate label.
No claim beyond the public model-card usage example is inferred from this specimen.
